summary: Players lead one of four Minoan clans, using action and open drafting along with dice rolling to take actions, earn income, and move across the map, competing through governance and cultivation of their clan's identity rather than warfare. Area majority/influence determines control as clans jockey for position toward the title of Minos.

interaction.detail: Clans contest control of shared areas through area majority/influence and draft from common action pools, putting players in direct competition for the same spaces and options. Each clan also develops its own variable powers and identity on a separate part of its board.

scoring.how_you_win: The clan that best establishes governance, prosperity, and area influence over the other clans is declared Minos, the ultimate leader of the Minoan people.

_name: Minos: Dawn of the Bronze Age
